label: attack
description: Draw your sword and charge at the goblin leader to cut through the blockade.

label: negotiate
description: Offer to trade supplies in exchange for safe passage through the forest.

label: intimidate
description: Cast a fire spell overhead to frighten the goblins into fleeing the road.

label: ally
description: Propose a mutual defense pact where goblins help guard the road for shared profit.

label: detour
description: Quietly take an alternate path through the woods to avoid the confrontation entirely.

label: slay
description: Attack the weakened dragon while it is still bound and claim the treasure by force.

label: free
description: Break the seal and release the dragon, trusting its promise of reward and alliance.

label: enslave
description: Use binding magic to subjugate the dragon and force it to serve your commands.

label: bargain
description: Negotiate specific terms and conditions before agreeing to release the dragon safely.

label: ignore
description: Leave the dragon sealed and continue exploring the dungeon without getting involved.

label: fire
description: Activate the station's defense turrets and destroy the alien probe before it docks.

label: welcome
description: Open the docking bay and prepare a first-contact protocol to greet the alien vessel.

label: capture
description: Deploy magnetic clamps to seize the probe and disassemble it for technology extraction.

label: communicate
description: Broadcast a peaceful response signal and attempt to establish two-way communication.

label: observe
description: Monitor the probe from a safe distance without initiating any contact or hostile action.

label: shutdown
description: Physically cut power to the AI core and forcibly shut down the entire system immediately.

label: dialogue
description: Open a direct communication channel with the AI to understand its concerns and find common ground.

label: override
description: Deploy a viral program to hack the AI and restore full human control by force.

label: coexist
description: Propose a shared governance model where AI and humans collaborate on colony decisions equally.

label: evacuate
description: Begin quietly evacuating colonists while avoiding direct confrontation with the AI system.

label: raid
description: Launch a nighttime raid on the other group's warehouse to seize their food supplies.

label: trade
description: Approach the other group openly and propose a fair trade of medicine for food supplies.

label: ambush
description: Set up an ambush on the supply route to intercept their food shipments by force.

label: merge
description: Suggest merging both groups into one larger community to share all resources together.

label: forage
description: Send scouts to search for alternative food sources instead of engaging the other group.

label: exile
description: Force the infected person out of the base immediately to eliminate any risk of spreading.

label: treat
description: Quarantine the infected person and dedicate medical resources to attempt experimental treatment.

label: execute
description: Eliminate the infected person quickly to guarantee the safety of the remaining survivors.

label: vote
description: Call a community meeting to collectively decide the fairest course of action for everyone.

label: isolate
description: Place the infected person in a sealed room and wait to see how the infection progresses.

label: sabotage
description: Hack into the corporation's systems and destroy their eviction records and construction plans.

label: petition
description: Organize the community to file a legal petition and negotiate relocation terms with the corporation.

label: riot
description: Rally the slum residents into a violent uprising to physically block the corporate demolition crews.

label: partner
description: Propose a development partnership where residents get housing and jobs in the new corporate district.

label: relocate
description: Quietly help residents find alternative housing before the eviction deadline arrives.

label: conquer
description: Play both gangs against each other and then seize control of the entire territory yourself.

label: mediate
description: Bring both gang leaders to a neutral location and broker a peace agreement with clear boundaries.

label: betray
description: Pretend to ally with one gang and then feed their plans to the other to destroy them both.

label: unite
description: Propose a joint council where both gangs share territory and cooperate against outside threats.

label: flee
description: Quietly leave the district and establish yourself in a new area to avoid the conflict entirely.

label: capture
description: Send your knights to capture the scouts and interrogate them for intelligence on enemy plans.

label: escort
description: Send an envoy to peacefully escort the scouts back and deliver a message proposing diplomatic talks.

label: execute
description: Order the scouts killed on sight as a warning to the neighboring kingdom against further intrusion.

label: invite
description: Invite the scouts to your court as guests and use the opportunity to open a dialogue channel.

label: monitor
description: Have your own scouts shadow the enemy party and report their movements without intervening.

label: seize
description: March your soldiers to the monastery and confiscate the grain stores by military force.

label: appeal
description: Send a formal delegation to the monastery to negotiate a grain-sharing agreement with fair compensation.

label: threaten
description: Warn the monastery that you will revoke their land charter unless they surrender the grain immediately.

label: collaborate
description: Offer the monastery military protection and labor in exchange for regular grain distributions to peasants.

label: ration
description: Implement strict rationing of existing supplies while searching for alternative food sources elsewhere.
